title: Restlessness Has More Static
caption: Your body may prefer a gentler pace today. Keep your pace slow: take short breaks and space big tasks so they don’t all land at once.
snapshot: The near-Earth environment is a touch unsettled after some recent solar activity and a livelier background resonance. Expect a bit more variability in how the body reads signals. Aurora chances are quiet but watchful over the next few days.
affects: Sleep may be lighter or slower to come for some people. Restlessness or repeated wakings can show up even if you feel worn out. If you notice more mental chatter at night, that could be tied to the unsettled backdrop.
playbook:
- Keep screens dim and brief in the hour before bed
- Try a short calm-breathing set in bed to slow the pace
- Trade heavy late meals or caffeine for lighter, earlier options
- Use soft lighting and a consistent bedtime step to cue rest

fb.caption: Can’t sleep but your mind is oddly jumpy? That restless feeling can come from small bursts of space activity that make body rhythms twitchy for some folks. There’s been recent CME activity and the planet’s background electrical hum is a touch livelier than usual, which tends to give nights a choppier feel. That doesn’t mean anything dramatic will happen — just expect more micro-awakenings or a harder time settling. Keep the evening simple: dim screens, skip heavy food late, and favor slow breath for a few minutes before bed. If you notice jittery nights, shorten evening demands and let rest come in stages instead of forcing a long sleep. Check Gaia Eyes for the quick snapshot and pace the night in small steps.
